events.title: Two weeks 'til Early Access
events.summary: Greetings Booklings, Two weeks ’til Bookly launches into Early Access on 30 October! The demo is out for Steam Next Fest, and we’ve reached 100 wishlists—thank you! I’ve also added custom sorting and theme options for a little extra challenge. I’m spending these final weeks fixing bugs, polishing the game and getting everything as ready as I can. Give the demo a try, and wishlist Bookly if you enjoy it! Happy sorting,Samly

events.title: 100 Wishlists !
events.summary: Greetings Booklings,Thank you so much for helping get Bookly to 100 wishlists! It's been amazing to see so many of you interested in playing my game, and honestly, quite emotional. With the demo now live, and a release date of 30th October 2026 (less than 3 weeks away!), I've been hard at work getting the game as feature-full as I can for going into Early Access. events.title: Patch 2026.30
events.summary: Greetings Booklings, Big announcement—Bookly has a release date! The full game will be available on October 30th, 2026, just in time for Halloween. Until then, the demo is now live, giving you full access to the Village level! Alongside that, split-screen is finally here! Fancy playing on the couch with a friend? Well now you can.
